claims.claim: never buy an item because it's cheap

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or blockage in the cooling passages.
risks.proof: A video showing a pressure test or a clear photo of the interior with a pressure gauge.

risks.risk: Leaks at the mounting brackets or hose fittings.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bracket joints and the hose connection points.

risks.risk: Incorrect fitment for the specific vehicle model.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's part number plate or a photo of the car it is intended for.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic radiator without a specific fitment value

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the part number or model code stamped on the radiator.
Video of a pressure test to check for leaks.
Close-up photos of the mounting bracket joints and hose fittings.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
